objective.name: wrapper_stop
objective.description: Internal reserved execution signal acknowledging wrapper stop.

#root.role: Accept the reserved internal wrapper-stop signal without mutating runtime state.

transformation_contract.morphing: An internal wrapper-stop acknowledgement is absorbed as a stable reserved execution signal with no direct runtime mutation.
invariants: wrapper_stop is an internal one-way execution signal and does not emit a response payload.
The current implementation intentionally treats wrapper_stop acknowledgements as no-ops inside Execution.
Process-level stop enforcement is owned by lower runtime layers, not by this handler.
success: Successful handling consists of accepting the reserved signal without mutating wrapper runtime state.
The absence of state mutation is part of the current contract.
failure: wrapper_stop has no parameter-level failure contract in the current implementation because it is treated as a reserved no-op.
Unknown or malformed internal callers simply result in no observable runtime mutation.
notes: This capability is reserved for internal execution signalling and is not a user-facing orchestration primitive.
If stop acknowledgements gain runtime effects later, this contract must be updated with the new observable mutation semantics.
